title: pi
intro: pi (earendil-works), headless over `pi -p --mode json`. pi reads no base-URL variable, so the folder writes `$HOME/.pi/agent/models.json` every turn with a custom provider pointing at the gateway and `apiKey: "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"`, which pi expands from the environment.
notes: The session id is the platform's own (`--session-id $HI_SESSION`), so every later turn resumes the same pi session from the same workspace.
`api: anthropic-messages` in the custom provider; for an OpenAI-chat provider use `openai-completions` and a `/v1` base.
`PI_OFFLINE=1` keeps pi from calling its catalog and version check.
